records.title: The Birth and Rescue of Moses
records.posterAlt: An Egyptian woman opens a woven basket holding a wrapped infant among Nile reeds. An imagined scene.
records.description: A woman in linen kneels among reeds and opens a woven basket. A wrapped infant rests inside. An attendant leans closer as a girl watches nearby. Ripples move across the Nile.
